title: bumelia americana
intro: Bumelia americana, commonly known as the American Zizia or American Bumelia, is a deciduous shrub native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and aid in the treatment of fever. The health benefits of Bumelia americana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
